svg.title: Image filters produce a feature row at each pixel
svg.desc: Measured LuCa DAPI and CMU-1 green-channel crops, each 128 by 128 pixels. At a one-micrometre Gaussian standard deviation, all ten supported QuPath filters describe local intensity, edges, curvature and directional texture. The marked pixel is fixed across every plane of a specimen. Its measured feature values are shown below each plane. Each plane has labelled display endpoints; signed curvature uses blue for negative, white for zero and red for positive. The three displayed feature groups join into eleven values per pixel for this one-channel, one-scale recipe.
